findings.evidence: InboundWebhooksController reads Request.Body to end before any explicit application payload-size guard, and no regression proves an oversized payload is rejected with zero persistence.
findings.required_recovery: Add a deterministic application-level payload limit and regression proving oversized payload rejection before persistence/effects.

findings.evidence: Secret lookup is tenant-scoped in the controller, but the test suite exercises only one tenant and does not prove a request signed for one tenant cannot be accepted on another tenant route or create cross-tenant persistence.
findings.required_recovery: Add a controller-level tenant-mismatch regression using distinct tenant secrets and verify rejection plus zero cross-tenant persistence.
